multi_entity_note: Agreement between The Victory Portfolios (Trust) and Hartford Life Insurance Co. (Administrator), with several addresses.
processing_note: Payment shall be in federal funds transmitted by wire to the Fund's designated custodian.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading names the contract SERVICE AGREEMENT.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is entered into as of 9/28/2004; the signature line gives only month and year in the marked span.

contract.effective_date.rationale: No separate effective date; the agreement is made as of 9/28/2004, which is when it takes effect.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement has no fixed term; it runs until terminated on 90 days notice.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 17 selects the internal laws of the State of Ohio.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal, so no non-renewal notice period; 90 days is a termination-for-convenience notice.
